access_scope: Retained indexed primary publisher full-text/Table1 snapshot, not a downloaded PDF; direct public article/PDF GET was denied. No authentication bypass.
audit_method: Independently parsed original indexed Table1 payload directly; did not load table1_transcription.json or normalize_table1.py to derive expected values. Compared all 67 locators, conditions, stress centers, reported ±, exponents, events, failure lives and censor lower bounds.

interpretation.runouts: Methods defines survival without fracture to N >= 5e6. Four Runout tokens support a conservative censor lower bound at 5e6; their actual individual stop cycles are not given and remain blank.
interpretation.beyond_threshold_failure: 450C as-built at 140 ± 2 MPa reports 6.07e6 numerically; retain as failure. Minimum-survival runout definition does not prove mandatory termination at exactly 5e6. No contradiction/error allegation is justified.
interpretation.stress_domain: R=-1 nominal bending stress amplitude with a surface-to-center stress gradient; keep separate from uniform axial HCF pool.
interpretation.reuse: 25C as-built reference S-N curve explicitly reused from authors previous study [66], Crossref bibliography DOI 10.1016/j.ijfatigue.2024.108491. The remaining42 are not this explicitly reused curve; no globally unique specimen/independence claim.
interpretation.identity: Generated Table1 row/column/point locators are publication locators only, never author lab/build/powder IDs. Fig1 build plates do not furnish a per-point physical-build crosswalk.
interpretation.as_built: Author condition label; current-paper samples were stress relieved 550C/6h before separation, with HIP subset at1150C/100MPa/4h. Prior reused curve processing is not silently transferred.
interpretation.fit_status: Separate curation panel, not used by frozen v4 models.

reproduction_note: The row parser was executed in the independent audit command; no raw/source/normalization files were changed.
